query: UPDATE mcp_tools SET title = $3, description = $4, input_schema = $5, output_schema = $6, annotations = $7, meta = $8, definition_hash = $9, approved_hash = COALESCE($10, approved_hash), approved = COALESCE($11, approved), state = CASE WHEN $9 = COALESCE($10, approved_hash) THEN 'active' ELSE 'changed' END, changed_at = CASE WHEN $9 = COALESCE($10, approved_hash) THEN changed_at ELSE $12 END, updated_at = $12 WHERE id = $1 AND name = $2
